title: External global derived Hom evaluation respects coefficient cones
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X,Y,P$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $a:P\to X$, $b:P\to Y$ be scheme morphisms. Work on small representatives of their small etale sites in a common module universe [def-weil-size-convention], with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Inverse image is the constant-coefficient inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and all tensor products are derived with the direct-sum total convention [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and suppose $F=a^{-1}K\otimes_A^Lb^{-1}L$ is bounded below. Let $E$ on $X$ and $H$ on $Y$ be bounded cochain complexes of flat $A$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For any such coefficient complex $G$ on a scheme $T$ and bounded-below $M$, write
$$\mathsf H_T(G,M)=R\Gamma(T,R\mathcal Hom_A(G,M))\in D(A),$$
where $R\mathcal Hom$ is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and $R\Gamma$ means right-derived global sections. Equivalently this is represented by the complex of global morphisms $\operatorname{Hom}^{\bullet}_T(G,I)$ for a bounded-below injective representative $I$ of $M$, with the Hom differential of [def-pur-hom-complex]. Write $\underline Q_T$ for the termwise constant sheaf complex associated to an $A$-complex $Q$.

There is a canonical morphism
$$\lambda_{E,H}:\mathsf H_X(E,K)\otimes_A^L\mathsf H_Y(H,L)\longrightarrow\mathsf H_P(a^{-1}E\otimes_A^Lb^{-1}H,F).$$
It is the transpose, for global derived Hom and constant sheaves, of the two evaluation maps $\underline{\mathsf H_X(E,K)}_X\otimes_A^LE\to K$ and $\underline{\mathsf H_Y(H,L)}_Y\otimes_A^LH\to L$, pulled back to $P$ and tensored with the Koszul interchange. Its ordinary Hom-complex pairing sends homogeneous maps $f,g$ and local homogeneous elements $e,h$ to
$$(f\otimes g)(e\otimes h)=(-1)^{\deg(g)\deg(e)}a^{-1}f(e)\otimes b^{-1}g(h).$$
This normalization descends canonically through K-flat tensor and K-injective Hom resolutions.

The morphisms $\lambda_{E,H}$ are natural contravariantly in $E,H$ and covariantly in $K,L$, and commute with open restriction of $X$ or $Y$ and the induced restriction of $P$. For fixed $H$, if $E_2\to E_1\to E_0\to E_2[1]$ is a distinguished triangle represented by bounded flat complexes, the three maps $\lambda_{E_0,H},\lambda_{E_1,H},\lambda_{E_2,H}$ form a morphism of distinguished triangles from
$$\mathsf H_X(E_0,K)\otimes_A^L\mathsf H_Y(H,L)\longrightarrow\mathsf H_X(E_1,K)\otimes_A^L\mathsf H_Y(H,L)\longrightarrow\mathsf H_X(E_2,K)\otimes_A^L\mathsf H_Y(H,L)$$
to the contravariant global-Hom triangle of $a^{-1}E_i\otimes_A^Lb^{-1}H$ into $F$. The same assertion holds with $E$ fixed and a triangle in $H$. Distinguished triangles and shifts use [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-triangulated-category]. In particular these are the specified evaluation maps on all three terms, including the cone term, and the square on the connecting morphism commutes. In the first case the right-tensor shift comparison is $x\otimes y\mapsto x\otimes y$; in the second case the left-tensor shift comparison is $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{\deg(x)}x\otimes y$.

source.place: Tag 08JC, lemma-RHom-triangulated; section-internal-hom and section-hom-complexes. The external global-Hom evaluation transformation and its compatibility with both coefficient cones are an agent-formulated refinement of the Hom-complex constructions.
